name: unigram empirical and smoothed perplexity
test:
import math
empirical = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=0.0).train("aab")
assert math.isclose(empirical.evaluate("ab"), math.sqrt(4.5), rel_tol=1e-9)
smoothed = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=1.0).train("aab")
assert math.isclose(smoothed.evaluate("ab"), math.sqrt(25 / 6), rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isinf(smoothed.evaluate(""))
assert math.isinf(smoothed.evaluate("az"))

name: bigram training resets previous state
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2, alpha=0.0)
assert model.train("ababa") is model
assert math.isclose(model.evaluate("ab"), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
model.train("bb")
assert math.isclose(model.evaluate("bb"), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("ab"))

name: smoothing supports held-out contexts
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=3, alpha=0.5).train("abcdabcd")
score = model.evaluate("dcba")
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert score >= 1.0
unsmoothed = NGramCharModel(n=3, alpha=0.0).train("abcdabcd")
assert math.isinf(unsmoothed.evaluate("dcba"))
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("abcx"))

name: generation uses frequency top one
test:
model = NGramCharModel(n=2).train("ababababac")
assert model.generate("a", max_new_chars=6) == "abababa"
assert model.generate("seed", max_new_chars=0) == "seed"
fallback = NGramCharModel(n=2).train("aaab")
assert fallback.generate("z", max_new_chars=3) == "zaaa"

name: invalid arguments and untrained behavior
input: n = 0, empty train text, untrained generation
test:
import math

def expect_value_error(callable_obj):
    try:
        callable_obj()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(n=0))
model = NGramCharModel()
expect_value_error(lambda: model.train(""))
expect_value_error(lambda: model.generate("", max_new_chars=1))
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("abc"))
model.train("abc")
expect_value_error(lambda: model.generate("", max_new_chars=-1))

name: invalid smoothing argument
tiny Shakespeare held-out train generate evaluate workflow
test:
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

data_root = os.environ.get("DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH")
assert data_root, "DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH must point to a directory containing tiny_shakespeare.txt"
text = (Path(data_root) / "tiny_shakespeare.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
assert len(text) >= 1000, "tiny_shakespeare.txt is unexpectedly small for a held-out split"
cut = int(len(text) * 0.8)
train_text = text[:cut]
validation_text = text[cut:]
assert len(validation_text) >= 200, "validation split is too small"
missing_chars = set(validation_text) - set(train_text)
assert not missing_chars, f"validation split contains chars not present in training: {sorted(missing_chars)!r}"
model = NGramCharModel(n=4, alpha=0.1).train(train_text)
prompt = validation_text[:40]
generated = model.generate(prompt, max_new_chars=120)
assert generated.startswith(prompt)
assert len(generated) == len(prompt) + 120
assert set(generated[len(prompt):]) <= set(train_text)
heldout = validation_text[:1000]
score = model.evaluate(heldout)
unigram_score = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=0.1).train(train_text).evaluate(heldout)
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert math.isfinite(unigram_score)
assert 1.0 <= score
assert score < unigram_score * 0.85, (score, unigram_score)
